spans.text: Keeping a team fully booked backfires: beyond a certain point, each extra percent of utilization buys a disproportionate amount of waiting.
The chapter first shows how waiting grows slowly and then steeply as a single server gets busier.
It then adds variability as the second cause of waiting, alongside utilization.
It closes by recasting slack as capacity held in reserve for unpredictable work rather than as waste.
